quality_policy.user_requirement: Exact CUDA/MLU output identity is not required. Establish practical quality and implementation correctness.
quality_policy.threshold_status: Proposed engineering policy, not an official OneRec or universal GR certification threshold.
quality_policy.selection_timing: Selected after initial interactive results and a video prefix had been observed; the policy is exploratory, not preregistered.
quality_policy.uncertainty: 5000 paired user-cluster bootstrap replicates; per-metric one-sided 95% lower bound for MLU - 0.99*CUDA must be nonnegative. Non-significance does not establish equivalence.
quality_policy.decision: Pass only if every primary metric passes; evidence of degradation if any upper one-sided 95% contrast bound is negative; otherwise inconclusive.
quality_policy.fixed_benchmark_gate: Also report whether each observed MLU score is >= 99% of observed CUDA; a confidence-inconclusive result does not erase an observed threshold miss.
quality_policy.scope: OneRec-1.7B, BF16, TP1, eager ModelRunner V2, batch 1, beam 32, 3 SID tokens, RecIF interactive and video.
structural_checks: beam update and tie rules using identical logits
prefix-cache and request-order checks on short and long inputs
native request state release across repeated requests
output row, token length and sequence-count integrity
invalid SID and unmapped PID rates reported without filtering
not_established: Universal correctness for every input, model or mode
Graph, TP>1, multi-request batching or unsupported features

sources.title: OpenOneRec Technical Report, section 3.3
sources.supports: Official recommendation metrics Pass@1, Pass@32, Recall@32.

sources.title: TIGER, NeurIPS 2023, section 4
sources.supports: Generative retrieval evaluated using Recall and NDCG at K=5,10. NDCG@32 here is an explicitly selected extension.

sources.title: MLPerf Inference accuracy targets
sources.supports: Default 99% and high-accuracy 99.9% reference-relative thresholds; precedent, not a OneRec-specific rule.

sources.title: MLCommons DLRMv3 generative recommendation benchmark
sources.supports: Reference-relative quality validation for a generative recommendation ranking model; uses NE, Accuracy, AUC and 99.9% target. Those ranking metrics are not substituted for OneRec SID retrieval metrics.

coverage_extension.initial_selection: 1000 rows per task, seeded 20261127 before observing those outcomes
coverage_extension.full_ad_followup: All 27677 rows, added after the fixed ad sample showed degradation. Initial sample remains reported.

policy.status: Proposed engineering policy; not an official OneRec threshold.
policy.statistic: MLU mean minus retention times CUDA mean
policy.pass_rule: One-sided 95% lower percentile bootstrap bound >= 0 for every primary metric.

bootstrap.aggregation: Row-weighted mean; whole users resampled together.
bootstrap.limitation: Assumes sampled users represent the target population; intervals are per metric.
